title: tests + docs: sha3-384 and sha3-512 test cases and DESIGN.md update
description:
Add sha3-384 and sha3-512 test cases to test_chardev.c and update DESIGN.md algorithm coverage.

**What:** Wire known-answer test cases for sha3-384 and sha3-512 into the userspace test suite, and update the DESIGN.md algorithm coverage table.

**Algorithm (test_chardev.c):**
1. Add #include "../vectors/sha3.h" (already included for sha3-256 vectors — verify before adding)
2. Add test_sha3_384_vectors() function: same structure as test_sha256_vectors(), using SHA3_384_VECTOR_COUNT, sha3_384_vectors[i].input/input_len/digest, read size = 48 bytes, algo = "sha3-384"
3. Add test_sha3_512_vectors() function: same pattern, SHA3_512_VECTOR_COUNT, 64 bytes
4. Add both functions to the test table: { "SHA3-384 known-answer vectors", test_sha3_384_vectors }, { "SHA3-512 known-answer vectors", test_sha3_512_vectors }
5. Position both entries near the existing sha256 vector test entries

**Algorithm (DESIGN.md):**
1. In the Algorithm Coverage table (after sha3-256 row), add:
   | `sha3-384` | FIPS | yes | wolfssl wins when loaded |
   | `sha3-512` | FIPS | yes | wolfssl wins when loaded |

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Test function must check return of ioctl and read separately, reporting which step failed
- Digest comparison must use memcmp, not strcmp
- Each test case must print the test vector source on failure (sha3_384_vectors[i].source)
- No modification to existing tests; new functions only
